description: Helper functions for testing bitmap performance in a Git repository. Contains functions that execute Git commands to simulate cloning, rev-list operations, packing, and repacking with various bitmap index configurations.

methods.name: test_full_bitmap
methods.description: Function that runs multiple performance tests related to full bitmap indexing in Git.

methods.name: test_partial_bitmap
methods.description: Function that tests partial bitmap index scenarios in Git.

methods.name: test_pack_bitmap
methods.description: Function that tests pack and repack operations involving bitmap indexes, including creating a specific bitmap state.
